title: Rust SAN address binding validator
description: Implement the Rust leaf-certificate SAN binding checks from R-X509-016/018/051 in the gateway credential path: require exactly one native 0200::/8 iPAddress equal to upstream AddrForKey(subject SPKI), reject zero/multiple/mismatch and forbidden names, ignore non-native iPAddress entries, and enforce SAN criticality iff subject is empty. Add independent tests with pinned fixtures.
close_reason: Implemented and wired Rust SAN binding validation; added pinned Ed25519 chain tests for required/rejected/ignored SAN cases. Full gateway suite passed. Kimi correctness/security/edge reviews unavailable due insufficient OpenRouter credits; local fallback reviews found no additional defects.
